message: Exact #2805 head 76d2ed5: all three selective-graft package assertions are inherited source-contract drift, not verifier-custody failures. TuyaAccountBridge no longer retains/fetches selectedDeviceLocalStrategy; current retained opaque payloads are metadata/status/specifications and are recursively secret-redacted plus final-envelope account-UID-redacted, so the two localStrategy/strategy exact-substring tests are stale and should be reconciled to current retained payload custody without weakening redaction. Podfile.lock behavior is fail-closed via [[ -f Podfile.lock ]] || { ... }; the test's required literal [[ ! -f Podfile.lock ]] is stale syntax, not a behavior regression. Separately, build_guard main() still has undefined private_review exception matching. Minimal regression: patch _parse_args to return a sentinel input/command, patch run_guarded_build to raise RuntimeError('sentinel'), and assert main([]) propagates RuntimeError rather than masking it with NameError; then remove the stale undefined exception clause. PHYSICAL NO-GO.
